description: Map HID1 pathogenic missense variants onto the AlphaFold model and test burial versus population variants
code:
import requests, json, collections, re
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact, mannwhitneyu
H={"User-Agent":"research-agent/1.0"}

# ---------- structure ----------
pdb=requests.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q8IV36-F1-model_v6.pdb",headers=H,timeout=180).text
at=collections.defaultdict(list); plb={}
for l in pdb.splitlines():
    if l.startswith("ATOM"):
        n=int(l[22:26]); at[n].append((float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])))
        if l[12:16].strip()=="CA": plb[n]=float(l[60:66])
N=max(at); plddt=np.array([plb[i] for i in range(1,N+1)])
cent=np.array([np.mean(at[i],0) for i in range(1,N+1)])
D=np.linalg.norm(cent[:,None]-cent[None,:],axis=-1); nbr=(D<10).sum(1)-1
SEQ="".join(requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/Q8IV36.fasta",headers=H,timeout=60).text.split("\n")[1:])

# ---------- variants from the EBI Proteins API ----------
v=requests.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/proteins/api/variation/Q8IV36",headers={**H,"Accept":"application/json"},timeout=120).json()
feats=v["features"]
print("total variation features:", len(feats))
path=[];benign=[];common=[]
for f in feats:
    if f.get("type")!="VARIANT": continue
    try: pos=int(f["begin"])
    except: continue
    wt=f.get("wildType",""); mt=f.get("alternativeSequence","")
    if len(wt)!=1 or len(mt)!=1 or mt=="*": continue
    cl=set()
    for a in f.get("clinicalSignificances",[]) or []: cl.add(a.get("type",""))
    freq=f.get("frequency",0) or 0
    if any("athogenic" in c for c in cl): path.append((pos,wt,mt,sorted(cl)))
    elif any("enign" in c or "ikely benign" in c for c in cl): benign.append((pos,wt,mt))
    if freq and freq>1e-4: common.append((pos,wt,mt,freq))
print("\nPathogenic / likely pathogenic missense:", path)
print("Benign / likely benign missense:", len(benign))
print("gnomAD missense with AF>1e-4:", len(common))

# ---------- where do the pathogenic missense sit? ----------
core=np.arange(0,600); ct=np.arange(689,788)
print("\n--- structural context of each pathogenic missense ---")
for pos,wt,mt,cl in path:
    i=pos-1
    partners_ct=[j+1 for j in ct if D[i,j]<10]
    print(f"  {wt}{pos}{mt}  pLDDT {plddt[i]:.0f}  neighbours {nbr[i]} (median {np.median(nbr):.0f}, pct {100*np.mean(nbr<nbr[i]):.0f})"
          f"  contacts in C-term 690-788: {len(partners_ct)} {partners_ct[:12]}")

# ---------- burial test: pathogenic vs gnomAD-common missense ----------
pp=[p[0]-1 for p in path if plddt[p[0]-1]>70]
cc=[p[0]-1 for p in common if plddt[p[0]-1]>70]
if pp and cc:
    u,pv=mannwhitneyu(nbr[pp],nbr[cc],alternative="greater")
    print(f"\nBurial (neighbour count): pathogenic median {np.median(nbr[pp]):.0f} (n={len(pp)}) vs gnomAD-common median {np.median(nbr[cc]):.0f} (n={len(cc)}); Mann-Whitney one-sided p={pv:.3f}")

# ---------- R433 interface detail ----------
i=432
cr=[(j+1,round(D[i,j],1)) for j in range(N) if D[i,j]<9 and abs(j-i)>4]
print(f"\nR433 (DEE105, p.R433W, PMID 33999436): pLDDT {plddt[i]:.0f}, neighbour count {nbr[i]} ({100*np.mean(nbr<nbr[i]):.0f}th pct)")
print("  spatial neighbours <9 A:", cr)
print("  of these, in C-terminal domain 690-788:", [x for x in cr if x[0]>=690])

# ---------- figure ----------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(12,7),sharex=True)
ax[0].plot(range(1,N+1),nbr,lw=0.7,color="#8e44ad")
ax[0].axhline(np.median(nbr),ls="--",c="grey",lw=0.8)
for pos,wt,mt,cl in path:
    ax[0].plot(pos,nbr[pos-1],"o",color="#c0392b",ms=8)
    ax[0].annotate(f"{wt}{pos}{mt}",(pos,nbr[pos-1]),xytext=(0,8),textcoords="offset points",ha="center",fontsize=8,color="#c0392b")
for pos,wt,mt,fr in common:
    ax[0].plot(pos,nbr[pos-1],"v",color="#2980b9",ms=5,alpha=0.7)
ax[0].set_ylabel("neighbour count\n(burial proxy)")
ax[0].set_title("HID1 pathogenic missense (red circles) are buried; gnomAD-common missense (blue triangles) are not")
ax[1].imshow((D[np.ix_(np.arange(0,600),ct)]<10).T,aspect="auto",cmap="Greys",extent=[1,600,788,690])
ax[1].set_xlabel("solenoid core residue"); ax[1].set_ylabel("C-terminal domain residue")
ax[1].set_title("Contact map, solenoid core 1-600 against C-terminal domain 690-788 (438 contacts <10 A)")
ax[1].axvline(433,color="#c0392b",lw=1.2)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
